title: elephant-1 judge
description: Many text/JSON states with the same questions; each item is its own state, read in the key order sent.

items.description: One text/JSON state per item (string or any JSON value); input order is preserved. Over MCP an object loses its key order; to keep it, also send ordered_json: {"items": "<the same list as JSON text>"}.

questions.description: Question name → question. Names come back as the answers' keys; they are not shown to the model. Their order and each choice's option order set the prompt; over MCP send questions as their JSON text to keep both.

model.description: elephant-1; omit on this model’s operation endpoint.

bits.description: Required precision; 0 accepts the loaded FP16 and 16 matches it. Any other value returns 409.

question.description: A typed question about the state. Unknown fields are ignored.

type.description: noul = yes/no (answer P(yes)); choice = one of named options; score = an ordered level.

instructions.description: The question, as text or structured JSON. Optional; null or absent uses the default wording.

criteria.description: noul: optional {"true", "false"}; choice: options; score: levels, lowest first.

true.description: What this side means: text or structured JSON; null or absent uses the default wording.

false.description: What this side means: text or structured JSON; null or absent uses the default wording.

criteria.description: Optional {"true", "false"} descriptions; other keys are ignored, as the makers’ schema does.
Option label → description (null for the bare label), or a plain list of labels (batch extension). Labels are compared as exact strings.

items.description: What the option means: text, structured JSON, or null for the bare option.

criteria.description: Level descriptions, lowest first; levels are answered as "0", "1", …
